record.paper_title: Some Open Problems in Topological Algebra
record.original_question: If a paratopological group G is right ω-bounded, must it also be left ω-bounded? Here G is left ω-bounded if for every neighborhood U of the origin there exists a countable subset F of G such that G = F U, and right ω-bounded if for every neighborhood U there exists a countable subset F with G = U F.

evidence.quote:
A paratopological group G is left ω-bounded (resp. right ω-bounded) if for any neighborhood U ⊂ G of the origin there is a countable subset F ⊂ G with G = F U (resp. G = UF); G is ω-bounded if it is both left and right ω-bounded.
Problem 10 (Guran). Is a paratopological group G left ω-bounded if it is right ω-bounded?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a paratopological group, i.e. a group endowed with a topology such that the multiplication map $G\times G\to G$, $(x,y)\mapsto xy$, is jointly continuous (no continuity of inversion is assumed). Denote by $e$ the identity element of $G$. Call $G$:
- left $\omega$-bounded if for every neighborhood $U$ of $e$ there exists a countable subset $F\subseteq G$ with $G = FU$;
- right $\omega$-bounded if for every neighborhood $U$ of $e$ there exists a countable subset $F\subseteq G$ with $G = UF$.

Question: Must every right $\omega$-bounded paratopological group be left $\omega$-bounded?
artifact.status_search_result: A web search for this specific question of Guran on the equivalence of left and right $\omega$-boundedness for paratopological groups did not return a definitive resolution. Related literature on paratopological groups (boundedness, $\omega$-narrowness, C-compactness) exists, but no source explicitly confirms a solution to Guran's problem in either direction.

status_evidence.title: On paratopological groups
status_evidence.snippet: Survey-type paper on paratopological groups discussing various boundedness and narrowness conditions.
status_evidence.claim: Relevant background, but does not record a solution to Guran's left/right $\omega$-boundedness question.

status_evidence.title: A note on bounded sets and C-compact sets in paratopological groups
status_evidence.snippet: Studies weakly $\omega$-admissible paratopological groups and various boundedness notions.
status_evidence.claim: Does not resolve the left vs. right $\omega$-boundedness equivalence.
